scripts.build: pnpm --filter @show-me-once/shared build && pnpm --filter @show-me-once/extension build && pnpm --filter @show-me-once/web build
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @show-me-once/shared test && pnpm --filter @show-me-once/agent test && pnpm --filter @show-me-once/extension test && pnpm --filter @show-me-once/mcp test
scripts.mcp:bundle: rolldown packages/mcp/src/bridge-cli.ts --platform node --format esm --file dist/mcp/bridge.mjs && rolldown packages/mcp/src/server.ts --platform node --format esm --file dist/mcp/server.mjs && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/package-mcp.mjs
scripts.agent:bundle: rolldown packages/agent/src/bridge.ts --platform node --format esm --file dist/local-agent/bridge.mjs && node scripts/package-agent.mjs
